strengths: Top DEGs include multiple fibroblast/perivascular fibroblast markers (POSTN, FAP, ITGA11, OLFML2B, MAMDC2, LAMA4).

strengths: Some top DEGs are neuron-associated (NTNG2, BDNF, NR4A2, OPRK1, GPR63).
weaknesses: No canonical pan-neuronal markers (SNAP25, SYT1) or excitatory/deep-layer markers (SLC17A7, TBR1, BCL11B) in the DEG list.
Uses the same marker list dominated by fibroblast genes to support a non-hierarchical neuron branch without branch-specific positive evidence.

strengths: Correctly prioritizes fibroblast markers (POSTN, FAP, ITGA11, OLFML2B, MAMDC2, LAMA4) over broad pathway terms.
Rule-of-exclusion argument is consistent with absence of neuronal marker genes.
weaknesses: 'Perivascular fibroblast' specificity is not independently supported beyond the same fibroblast markers.
Reliance on absence of markers is a weaker positive evidence channel.

supporting: Top DEGs POSTN, FAP, ITGA11, OLFML2B, MAMDC2, LAMA4, FBLN5, NPNT are direct positive markers of fibroblast/perivascular fibroblast identity.
Two independent reviewers (CASSIA, enrichment) converge on CL:0000057, consistent with the majority branch anchor.
PMID 31888477 was retrieved from the cluster evidence set and is consistent with DLPFC fibroblast/perivascular fibroblast annotations.
conflicting: DEG list also contains neuron-associated genes (NTNG2, BDNF, NR4A2, OPRK1), but without pan-neuronal SNAP25/SYT1/SLC17A7.
In-house 'deep-layer glutamatergic neuron' label lacks TBR1/BCL11B/deep-layer excitatory markers and is not supported by branch-specific original evidence.
